tasks.label: BopPad: Make Windows Installer (Signed)
tasks.detail: Requires local signtool.exe and the KMI Music, Inc. code-signing cert (see apps/desktop/signWindows.js).

tasks.label: BopPad: Make Windows Installer (Unsigned)
tasks.detail: Skips code-signing entirely (KB_SKIP_WINDOWS_SIGN=1) — for quick local install/smoke testing.

tasks.label: BopPad: Make macOS Installer (Signed, Skip Notarize)
tasks.detail: Signed universal DMG, notarization skipped — fast local check. There is no fully-unsigned macOS build in this repo; Gatekeeper requires at least signing.

tasks.label: BopPad: Make macOS Installer (Signed + Notarized)
tasks.detail: Full release build: build, sign, package DMG, notarize, staple, regenerate channel metadata. Requires .env with APPLE_KEYCHAIN_PROFILE.

tasks.label: BopPad: Notarize Existing macOS DMG
tasks.detail: Reuses the already-built app + DMG in release/ and signs/notarizes/staples it. Requires .env with APPLE_KEYCHAIN_PROFILE.

tasks.label: BopPad: Deploy Web to mkMini (Dry Run)
tasks.detail: Preview only — no upload. Loads BP_WEB_SSH_* from the root .env.

tasks.label: BopPad: Deploy Web to mkMini (LIVE)
tasks.detail: Overwrites the production BopPad web editor. Confirm before running.

tasks.label: BopPad: Build + Deploy Web to mkMini (LIVE)
tasks.detail: Builds the web app then overwrites production. Confirm before running.

tasks.label: BopPad: Publish GitHub Release (Windows)
tasks.detail: Uploads the already-built, already-tested Windows installer in release/ to the GitHub Release. Requires the gh CLI authenticated with write access.

tasks.label: BopPad: Publish GitHub Release (macOS)
tasks.detail: Uploads the already-built, already-notarized macOS DMG in release/ to the GitHub Release. Requires the gh CLI authenticated with write access.
